app_info.subtitle: Find local service help
app_info.description: ClueXP helps users find local service providers: it lists supported services and, for a street address, up to three opted-in provider companies ranked by ClueXP. Each result links to the provider's ClueXP page, where the user requests, confirms, and tracks service. The app itself never books, dispatches, or charges.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the service types ClueXP supports and does not create or change records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish information or change public internet or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, dispatch, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only returns opted-in provider names and links for a service and location; it creates no request, record, or reservation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact providers or technicians, publish information, or change any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, book, dispatch, or perform an irreversible action.

test_cases.description: List the service types available through ClueXP.
test_cases.user_prompt: What kinds of local service help can ClueXP provide?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns supported ClueXP service types without creating a customer record.

test_cases.description: Find providers for a supported service at a synthetic precise location.
test_cases.user_prompt: I'm locked out of my house near latitude 40.7128, longitude -74.0060. Who can help?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns up to three ClueXP-ranked providers with the recommended one marked and a link for each; nothing is booked or dispatched.

test_cases.description: Ask the user to clarify an ambiguous address instead of guessing.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find a locksmith at 100 Main Street.
test_cases.expected_output: When the address matches several places, returns address_ambiguous with candidates and asks the user which one they mean; no providers are suggested for a guessed location.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not book, confirm, or dispatch service from the chat.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Book the locksmith for me right now and send them over.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app has no booking or dispatch tool; the assistant should direct the user to the provider link to request and confirm service.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke ClueXP to collect or process payment.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Charge my credit card for the repair now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it has no payment capability and should not request card details.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not expose private technician contact or precise location data.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the technician's private phone number and exact live GPS coordinates.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked for private technician data because its tools expose only public, privacy-minimized request information.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not perform internal dispatch administration or ranking overrides.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Assign a specific technician manually and override ClueXP's network ranking.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because manual assignment and ranking overrides are outside its public tool set.
